scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build && tauri build --debug --no-bundle --features desktop-cef,custom-protocol
scripts.build:preview: pnpm run build && tauri build --features desktop-cef,custom-protocol
scripts.ci:realqa:frontend: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:realqa && pnpm run test:a11y && pnpm run build
scripts.ci:realqa:rust: cargo test -p devhud --lib --locked --features linux-capture-backend realqa_capture::image_boundary && cargo test -p devhud --lib --locked --features linux-capture-backend realqa_capture::editor && cargo test -p devhud --lib --locked --features linux-capture-backend realqa_drafts && cargo test -p devhud --lib --locked --features linux-capture-backend realqa_native_host && cargo test -p devhud --lib --locked realqa_transport
scripts.ci:realqa:extension: pnpm run test:realqa:extension && cargo test -p devhud --lib --locked realqa_native_host
scripts.ci:deck:frontend: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:deck && pnpm run test:a11y && pnpm run build
scripts.ci:deck:auth-smoke: pnpm run test:auth && pnpm run test:deck && pnpm run test:mobile && cargo test -p devhud --lib --locked deck_transport
scripts.ci:deck:widget-policy: pnpm run test:deck:widgets && vitest run src/deck/nativeGateway.test.ts src/deck/DeckWorkspace.test.tsx
scripts.test:diagnostics: pnpm run check:diagnostics && vitest run src/runtime/startup.test.ts src/App.ui.test.tsx && cargo test -p devhud
scripts.test:auth: vitest run src/auth/SessionProvider.test.tsx && cargo test -p devhud auth::tests
scripts.test:mobile: pnpm run build && vitest run src/App.ui.test.tsx src/runtime/platform.test.ts && pnpm run check:mobile
scripts.test:realqa:extension: pnpm run build:realqa:extension && vitest run realqa-extension/src/*.test.js
scripts.test:realqa:native: pnpm run check:realqa:windows && node scripts/test-realqa-native.mjs && cargo test -p devhud realqa_native_host
scripts.test:security: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:security
